product_overview: Warden is a policy layer for Jira-changing AI agents. It deterministically allows, holds, or refuses proposed writes based on mandate rules, with admin controls and auditability around every decision.
core_goals: Protect Jira from unsafe or unauthorized AI-driven writes
Enforce per-agent mandates with deterministic allow/hold/deny decisions
Support burst, daily, hourly, and rule-based limits for agent actions
Provide admin tools to create, sanitize, pause, revoke, and inspect mandates
Enable approval workflows for held actions and preserve an audit trail

features.name: Policy evaluation (single write)
features.description: Evaluates one proposed Jira write against a mandate and usage history, returning allow, hold, or deny with all applicable reasons.
user_flows: POST /evaluate with a valid proposal, mandate, usage array, and now timestamp -> Receive 200 with decision allow and reasons array -> Use the verdict to proceed with the Jira write in the guarded action

POST /evaluate with a proposal that targets a blocked label or revoked mandate -> Receive 200 with decision deny and reason codes such as BLOCKED_LABEL or MANDATE_REVOKED -> Skip execution because denied writes never run
POST /evaluate with invalid JSON body or missing proposal field -> Receive 400 with error message -> Client surfaces validation failure and does not attempt Jira execution

features.name: Plan evaluation (bulk simulator)
features.description: Evaluates an ordered list of proposals as a batch, applying accumulated usage from earlier allowed or held items so limits are enforced across the plan.
user_flows: POST /evaluate-plan with an ordered array of valid proposals and optional usage -> Receive 200 with per-item results and summary counts -> Apply plan decisions while counting allowed and held items toward later limit checks

POST /evaluate-plan with multiple proposals that exceed burst or hourly limits partway through the sequence -> Receive 200 with later items denied and earlier eligible items allowed or held -> Refused items do not consume budget in the simulated plan
POST /evaluate-plan with proposals set to a non-array value -> Receive 400 with error message -> Client stops bulk simulation and reports invalid input

features.name: Mandate defaults and validation
features.description: Provides the default mandate for a fresh installation and sanitizes admin form input by normalizing values, trimming lists, and rejecting invalid constraints.
user_flows: GET /mandate/default -> Receive 200 with the default mandate including default projects, blocked labels, limits, hold rules, status, and expiry -> Pre-fill the admin configuration screen with the returned mandate

POST /mandate/sanitize with valid admin input and an optional previous mandate -> Receive 200 with a normalized mandate and incremented version -> Save the sanitized mandate for later policy evaluation
POST /mandate/sanitize with an invalid expiresAt value or perHour greater than perDay -> Receive 400 with error message -> Reject the form submission and keep the previous mandate unchanged

features.name: Health
features.description: Returns service liveness for the local policy harness.
user_flows: GET /health -> Receive 200 with { ok: true } -> Use the result to confirm the harness is running and ready for policy requests
GET /health while the harness is unavailable -> Receive a failed request or non-200 response -> Show the local service as unhealthy and block dependent test execution

tech_stack: Atlassian Forge (nodejs24.x runtime, Rovo agent, rovo:mcp, UI Kit)

features.name: Policy evaluation (single write)
features.description: Deterministic judge for one proposed Jira write by an AI agent. Returns decision allow, hold or deny with every reason code. Deny codes: MANDATE_REVOKED, MANDATE_PAUSED, MANDATE_EXPIRED, ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED, PROJECT_OUTSIDE_MANDATE, BLOCKED_LABEL, PROTECTED_ISSUE_TYPE, HOURLY_LIMIT, DAILY_LIMIT, RUN_LIMIT. Hold codes (only when there is no deny): SENSITIVE_LABEL, SENSITIVE_PRIORITY, SENSITIVE_STATUS, OUTSIDE_ASSIGNEE, LARGE_RUN, PROTECTED_GOAL, CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE. Label and name matching is case-insensitive. Missing mandate fields fall back to the default mandate; missing usage is []; missing now is the current time.

endpoints.description: Judge one proposal against a mandate (merged over the default mandate) and past usage

body.mandate: object (optional; e.g. projects string[], kinds string[], blockedLabels, holdLabels, protectedTypes, holdPriorities, holdStatuses, limits {perHour, perDay, perRun}, holdAboveRun number, status active|paused|revoked, expiresAt ISO string)
body.proposal: object (required; kind transition|assign|comment|set_priority, issueKey, projectKey, issueType, labels string[], priority, toStatus, assigneeOutsideProject boolean, protectedGoal string, contextUnavailable boolean, runId string)
body.usage: array of {at ISO string, runId string} (optional)

response_schema.400: { error } when proposal is missing, body is not JSON, usage is not an array or now is invalid

features.name: Plan evaluation (bulk simulator)
features.description: Judges a list of proposals in order. Each proposal sees the usage that earlier allowed or held proposals in the same plan would add, so limits are enforced across the plan. Refused items do not consume budget.

endpoints.description: Judge an ordered list of proposals and return per-item verdicts plus a summary

response_schema.200: { results: [{ issueKey, decision, reasons }], summary: { allow, hold, deny } }
response_schema.400: { error } when proposals is not an array

features.name: Mandate defaults and validation
features.description: Default mandate for a fresh install (projects [], blockedLabels [security], holdLabels [release-critical, customer-escalation], protectedTypes [Epic], holdPriorities [Highest], holdStatuses [Done, Closed], limits perHour 20 perDay 60 perRun 10, holdAboveRun 5, expires in 30 days, status active, version 1). Sanitize accepts admin form input, trims comma lists, upper-cases project keys, keeps only known kinds, bumps the version, and rejects an invalid expiry or an hourly limit above the daily limit.

endpoints.description: Validate and normalise admin input against a previous mandate (default if omitted)

body.input: object (name, kinds, projects, blockedLabels, holdLabels, protectedTypes, holdPriorities, holdStatuses, protectedGoals as arrays or comma strings, limits, holdAboveRun, expiresAt)

response_schema.400: { error } for invalid expiresAt or perHour greater than perDay

features.name: Health
features.description: Liveness check of the local harness

known_limitations.issue: Jira reads/writes, approvals and the ledger run only inside Forge and are not exposed by the local harness
known_limitations.impact: The harness tests the policy engine only; end-to-end Jira behaviour is tested on a Forge site
